dossier_meta.catalog_title: Research direction: minimal heroic tournament families
dossier_meta.statement_text: Characterize all finite and minimal families $\mathcal{H} = \{H_1, H_2, \ldots, H_k\}$ of tournaments such that $\{\overrightarrow{K_2}, \overleftrightarrow{K_2}, H_1, H_2, \ldots, H_k\}$ is a heroic set.
dossier_meta.context_text: Theorem 2.2 of Berger et al. [4] characterizes minimal heroic sets of this form with $|\mathcal{H}|=1$ (i.e., single-hero extensions). The authors note that a minimal heroic subset of order 2 or more cannot contain a hero tournament, making the general classification a natural open direction.
